build_BasicEncoder: build a feature encoder using BasicEncoder to extract 128-dim features from RGB images
build_SmallEncoder: build a lightweight feature encoder using SmallEncoder with BottleneckBlock for optical flow
create_ResidualBlock: create a ResidualBlock with configurable normalization and stride for feature extraction
create_BottleneckBlock: create a BottleneckBlock with 1x1-3x3-1x1 conv pattern for compact feature encoding
test_BasicEncoder_forward: test BasicEncoder forward pass with a batch of RGB image tensors
